items.headline: The AI data center boom is colliding with cities scarred by big industry
items.detail: National outcry against data center construction has spread to Philadelphia, where officials suggested possible construction in a neighborhood already impacted by a now-defunct oil refinery.

items.headline: Meta now lets AI agents handle the boring parts of WhatsApp Business setup
items.detail: A new WhatsApp Business MCP server lets developers use AI coding agents like Claude, Cursor, Codex, and ChatGPT to handle setup, messaging templates, testing, and troubleshooting.

items.headline: Voters mostly don’t like AI and data centers, but neither party seems to have an edge
items.detail: Poll data released Tuesday by the New York Times and Siena University confirms what we've already been seeing, and what politicians are responding to - AI and data centers are incredibly unpopular.

items.headline: Microsoft announces Windows and Surface event for October 7th
items.detail: It's been more than two years since the last major Windows event, so Microsoft is heading to San Francisco next month to outline the future of Windows and Surface devices.

items.headline: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff joins growing chorus of tech leaders warning about AI risks
items.detail: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff urged the AI industry to act responsibly as increasingly powerful models are developed.

items.headline: Nvidia's Huang rips Anthropic's proposal for AI safety antitrust waiver: 'Completely unnecessary'
items.detail: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang pushed back on calls to give AI companies antitrust exemptions to coordinate slowing the development of advanced models.

items.headline: AI app ads promoting 'objectification of women' banned by watchdog
items.detail: The ad regulator said it had "zero-tolerance" for ads promoting AI tools that could sexualise or objectify women.

items.headline: Nvidia boss says AI 'doesn't need new laws' as safety concerns grow
